item.title: New Study: Taking A Daily Multivitamin Slows The Ticking Of Epigenetic Clocks
item.description: A new study released by Mass General Brigham says that older adults taking a daily multivitamin may slow the aging process. This data is very interesting. NBC News reports, "In a randomized study of 958 older adults, those who took a multivitamin daily for two years experienced slowed so-called biological aging by about four months.
